scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Oh, I guess all is going well for you. So how has everything else been?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: I may be being overly sensitive, but it feels like something might happen soon. Aaah, don't mind me. It's no big deal. Maybe I'm just being weird.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Right, right, let me play a song for you. Would you care to listen?
Sure, why not~
How about some news?
No thanks.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
So, which song
would you like to hear?
Go ahead, pick one~
Bragi's Poem
Eternal Chaos
Assassin in the Sunset
Der Ring des Nibelungen

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Bragi's Poem!
What a good choice!
I must say this song
represents the
heart of a poet!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Eternal Chaos...
Sounds too chaotic.
By the way, I wonder
what the title really
means. Is it the chaos
of hell or our own reality?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Assassin in the Sunset!
Yes, no one looks cooler than an Assassin, the bringer of death, standing alone in the sunset! Heh heh~

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Der Ring des Nibelungen.....
Okay, are you ready to listen?
Hum hum hum....

^4D4DFFRheingold...
Hidden in the Rhein river.
If made into a ring,
Could rule the world~^000000

^4D4DFFProtected by a spell
Cursing its thief
To never find love.
Alberich had known
Nonetheless stole it.
Love was forsaken for power.^000000

^4D4DFFGiants built beautiful Valhalla
Matrimony with Freya
Goddess of beauty
Their supposed payment.
In not receiving it
They forcefully took her.^000000

^4D4DFFThe gods would
give Alberich's treasure
To the Giants for Freya's return.
Loki tricked Alberich,
Stealing his ring or power.^000000

^4D4DFFBut Alberich cursed his ring
Before it was returned to him,
Envy and death would
befall its wearers.^000000

^4D4DFFThe ring was given to the giants
Freya was returned to the gods
The giants killed themselves
Fighting over the rheingold,
Victims of Alberich's curse~^000000

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Some news you say..
What kind of news do
you wish to hear about?
About Prontera!
About coastal areas.
Is the desert still hot?
How about the borderlands?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
What?! Prontera?!
Can you not see that the front
gate of Prontera is right before you? You should at least know where you are, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Anyways, I have one interesting news about Prontera. But, it's a secret. Shh! Are you... Single?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: If so, go visit the tavern. I met a guy there who took to me a nice place. Oh yes. He took me to 'the place' where singles are forbidden~!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Coastal areas?
That's a funny question. I mean, there's Alberta and a few other places where you can see the sea.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
To the southwest there's
Kokomo Beach. But, I suppose it's too dangerous just to go there to take a stroll.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Kokomo Beach is a large
expanse of sand. The nearby water is filled with sea animals, so you can enjoy catching Shellfishes.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: However, there are always bullies in that kind of place. Once, I met a threatening looking hoodlum with red spiky hair.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: He was chewing on something and spat it on the ground. The big buffoon managed to intimidate me into giving him all of my Zeny!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
This world is too
dangerous for a young
and fragile Bard.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: By the way, Alberta doesn't seem to have changed. The Sunken Ship looks the same as well, with all of its Skeleton Pirates and whatnot. You know how it is.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: The event agency in charge of expeditions into the Sunken Ship is still making tons of money. If you have nothing to do, why don't you hunt for monsters down there?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Oh, hell yes!
When is it not?
The desert is hot, has
been hot and probably
always will be...!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Giant worms still jump out of nowhere, freaking out innocent travellers like myself, and the Sandmen still kick people in the, well... You know where.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Even if the desert is filled with hideous monsters, the view of the ocean there is so magnificent. Hah, it makes me want to play a song.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
I must say there is
one place you may wish
to see in the desert.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc Desert!
But you should know what I am talking about! So when are you gonna take me to the guild, eh?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
I'm talking about the Assassin Guild. Supposedly, it's hidden behind a sandstorm in the Morocc Desert!
Have you ever been there before?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Well, to the north is the Schwaltzwald Republic.
There, you'll find Juno,
the 'City of Sages.'

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
The people there say that there is one major nuisance, a man known as
the 'Mad Scientist.' He's antisocial and creates a lot of public disturbances with his experiments.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
It seems everyone in Juno
hates him with a passion. Even one of the Tool Shop owners begged a passing adventurer to stop this Mad Scientist's research!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: But I have a different opinion about him. I believe it's not a good idea to interrupt the work of any scientist.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: After all, he might just discover something important, even if his experiments are a little hazardous.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Speaking of discoveries, you know how Juno floats in the air, right?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
It's said that a piece of Ymir's Heart generates enough power
to keep the entire city aloft in the sky. Isn't that amazing?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Even more recent is the news about the discovery of Ymir's Book. You can read it in Juno's Sage Castle. I hear that it contains the secret to meeting Valkyrie...

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Huh? Okay then, talk to you later. May Bragi bless you on your journeys.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
So, have you
met Mr. Kaili?
Please do your best.
After all, I especially
recommended you~
Tell me a story.
Sing a song for me.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Hmm. What would
be a good story for
you this time...? Ah yes, I've got it. Let me tell you about one of my own adventures. It was a pretty amazing experience.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: I went to Morocc, the city of the desert. On my way there, I became exhausted from the heat. Luckily, I found a hole beneath the shadows and climbed in to rest.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Oh my God...
If I had known
better, I would have
never gone inside that place...

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: I actually crawled into the infamous ^FF0000Ant Hell^000000! I don't sound like a coward to you, do I?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Well, the ants aren't the only ones living there. I wasn't afraid of them at all. Except, of course, when they attacked in groups.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: What I was really afraid of was this type of strawberry colored... tongue thing. Phreeoni!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Fortunately, I survived the whole incident, although I still have nightmares of that man-sized tongue.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Once I got out of there, I craved human companionship to restore my sense of normalcy. The closest place that I knew was Paros Lighthouse.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Yet again, I decided to traverse the desert, despite the fact that the Kafra Ladies provide a very convenient teleport service there.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Anyway, the fortress of Sandaruman is on the way to Paros Lighthouse. I remember Serutero, a guy I met in south Morocc, telling me about its scenic beauty.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
I was so excited
about seeing it
for myself. After all, doesn't 'Sandaruman' sound like the
name of a beautiful place?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
But I immediately regretted my decision once I arrived. Of course, the view was breathtaking: the sandy hills near the ocean, as
well as the ruins.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: And of course I forgot Serutero's warning about all the monsters. Argh! It was a nightmare! Instead of enjoying the scenary, I ended up running for my life.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
I was still trying to escape those monsters when I stumbled upon
an old house, West of Sandaruman, that seemed to be in a state of decay.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: I recalled that Serutero said that no one was living in that area, so I began to worry a bit. Still, I was desperate and needed refuge.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: In my panic, I violently knocked on the door and screamed for someone to let me inside. Then do you know what I heard?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
^FF0000Who's there?!
Who would dare to intrude
upon my territory?^000000
I was freaked out! Whoever owned that house must have been some
kind of lunatic!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Th-then, with the specter of Death nipping at my heels, he told me to get lost! Luckily, I was saved by a mysterious, wandering SuperNovice, but that's another story.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: In any case, I finally arrived at Paros Lighthouse. There, I learned that the old house was a secret camp for the Rogue Guild.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: It's amazing, how they can live in such dangerous areas. Only Rogues would be able to survive there, you know?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Ah...
I'm so tired from talking so much. But if I happen to have another adventure, I shall share that tale with you.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Ah, you wish
to hear a song?
Okay! I shall then
perform my favorite.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
I chased after fame.
It eluded me.
I ran after happiness
But never caught it.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
But tomorrow will still
Be there, I'm sure.
Like the Water Mill
In Al De Baran
Which turns as
Life goes on.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Cheer up! Life goes on.
As surely as the Water
Mill turns, tomorrow
Will come.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Say...
Have we met before?
Hmm? Never? Well...
That's rather odd.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: I seem to recall that you've asked me to give you some information if I ever have any. Well, now I have and shall share it with you~

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: The usefulness of this information all depends on you. Now, have you heard of the ^3333CCMonster Research Organization^000000?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: I happened to get this information from its headquarters in Juno. So how does that sound?
Wee~ I want to hear!
Booooring~

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Well...!
You seem to be
very excited about
this new tidbit of
knowledge I have~

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Alas, this information doesn't seem to be very valuable to someone such as yourself.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: I'm so very sorry to have excited you, but only people that are strong enough to handle grueling work can benefit from this.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Why don't you travel around and gain more experiences? I will let you know when you're ready, you know~

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Ooh...
And you look
like you can handle
this kind of information.
I'll share everything I know!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: One day, an adventurer discovered a strange, mysterious object. Unable to figure out what it could do, he visited the Monster Organization.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: There, it was entrusted to a scholar by the name of Mr. Kaili. He still hasn't uncovered the truth about that item and wishes for assistance in his investigation.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Mr. Kaili suspects that the item might be part of an undiscovered ancient relic. Fortunately, he is also researching ancient relics as a project assigned by the royal court.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: So what do you think? Isn't that interesting? Of course, you'd better speak to Mr. Kaili if you wish to learn more. If you'd like, I shall write you a letter or recommendation.
Sure! Sounds good.
Sorry, I am not that interested.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Excellent...!
So your name is...
{0}?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Alright, I shall contact him right away! Oh, and you can find the Monster Organization west of Juno's central plaza. It shouldn't be hard to find. Good luck!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Ah, it's disappointing to hear that. I thought that you'd be perfect to help out Mr. Kaili. Oh well, talk to you later~

scripts.text:

Perhaps, but not as
boring as an adventurer
that passes up a chance
for an adventure, yes?
Tell me a story.
Sing a song for me.

scripts.text:
Hahahaha, forgive my rudeness,
but I fail to remember your name, although your face does seem rather familiar.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Oh well well...
How could I ever
forget the lovely
{0}?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: So, aren't you curious about me? Feel free to ask me whatever you like! I'm the vagabond that will wander the earth till the end of his days, your friend who loves to sing under the moonlight~
Who are you?
What's new?
Can you sing?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
Why, I am Nelliorde, the Bard.
In truth, my real name is Elliorde.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: However, while I was singing at a Tavern, as per usual, a man with long blonde hair angrily demanded that I change my name!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: Never before have I seen such a flailing and a fuss over someone coincidentally sharing the same name!

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
And so, that little altercation
was settled with me being named Nelliorde.

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text: I don't sound like a coward to you, do I? Do you believe I should have fought for the right to keep my original name?

scripts.speaker: Nelliorde
scripts.text:
If so, you're wrong! I just don't believe that violence can solve anything, as the romantic Bard
that cherishes peace...

^3355FFSeeing as it's not worth
listening to Nelliorde's lies, you decide to simply tune him out.^000000

you've returned.

scripts.text: Learning about Brisingamen was truly fascinating. But since we've hit a plateau for now, I've started a new research project.

scripts.speaker: Enrico Kaili
scripts.text:

fell into the waters.

scripts.speaker: Enrico Kaili

^333333*Ahem!*^000000 My reward!

scripts.speaker: Enrico Kaili

Oh, right.
Thank you for all the trouble you have endured for my sake. You are truly one of the best researchers I've ever met.

scripts.speaker: Enrico Kaili
scripts.text:
Then as promised...
I will give you something from my precious collection! Now, let me see what we have here...

scripts.speaker: Enrico Kaili
scripts.text:
Please...
Take this.

scripts.speaker: Enrico Kaili
scripts.text:
Please accept this as my way of thanking you for assisting in my
research. If the opportunity arises, I would like to ask you for your help once again. Now please, take care.

you're right.

scripts.speaker: Lowen Ellenen

scripts.text: We are indebted to you for reviving us. Okay, I know what you want, and will help you obtain the power of the gods.

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text:
What the...?
It's a human?!
What do you want?
Wh-who are you?
Dvalin wants you to wake up!
Tell me who you are first!

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text:
Dvalin?!
You mean my brother!
But he can only be revived if Alfrik is revived. What happened?

Umm...
Let me explain...
...So I guess I need to wake up all four of you dwarves so that Brisingamen, which holds Freya's power, can be made again.

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: Oh! Say that name once again! Freya, the goddess who took my body and soul! Did you just say you want to make her necklace?

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text:
Hahahaha!
Stop joking around.
The Brisingamen is
a one of a kind
masterpiece!
I don't mean the original one, but...

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text:
Ah, now I see! You want a replica that has roughly the same power.
A Brisingamen used by humans!
Very clever!

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: I, on the other hand, do not desire power. I would be happy to own but a strand of my goddess' hair.

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text:
Oh Freya...
The more of her beauty exists in this world, the happier I'll be. I'm more than willing to help you recreate this memento of Freya.

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: Now, please go and find the last one of my brothers! Poor Grer, perhaps he is still digging silver in that mine for her...

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: Go and find Grer. I will give you Freya's golden teardrop, but he might have revived on his own...

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text:
If he doesn't trust you, sing this song. You must remember each
and every word...

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: ^4d4dffNo jewel in the world can compare.^000000

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: ^4d4dffOur masterpiece made from love.^000000

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: ^4d4dffShe wanted the dazzling necklace.^000000

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: ^4d4dffWe wanted the goddess of beauty.^000000

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: ^4d4dffOur happiest times were with her.^000000

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: Memorize all five lines of this song exactly. Now take this golden teardrop and please seek out Grer.

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text:
Where the hell
did you come from?
I, Berling, refuse to
give my name to a rude,
ill-bred human like yourself!

Wait...
Your name
is Berling?

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text:
Baaaaahhh!
Quiet you!
Mind your own
business!

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: Did you already forget the lyrics? Let me tell them to you again, so don't forget this time.

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: ^4d4dffNo jewel in the world can compare.^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOur masterpiece made from love.^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffShe wanted the dazzling necklace.^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffWe wanted the goddess of beauty.^000000

scripts.speaker: Berling
scripts.text: ^4d4dffOur happiest times were with her.^000000
Bah, no way out.
Bah, no way out.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text: What!

Let's see.
Um, that song.
What was the first line...?

{0}
Alright, let's give it a try.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
Wha--?
Berling
did send you!

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
Bah!
I knew it!
I can't trust you!
^3355FFYou found a hole filled with some clod and a lump of coal.^000000
Beh, no way out.
Beh, no way out.

scripts.speaker: Male Voice
scripts.text:
Don't come any closer!
How the hell do I feel
Freya's presense on you?
Tell me who you are!
I am sent by Berling.
Wah, you freaked me out!

scripts.speaker: Male Voice
scripts.text:
Lies! Lies!
Prove it!
Prove yourself!

scripts.speaker: Male Voice
scripts.text: Get out of here!

scripts.speaker: Male Voice
scripts.text:
Prove it!
Otherwise, leave me alone and let me mine silver. Silver...! Heh heh heh...

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
As we promised,
Brisingamen will appear in front of human's eyes. But until then, I shall make jewelry of silver. Mwahahaha~

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
My name is Grer.
I should have been
the last one to be awakened. Now I see that I haven't mined as much silver as I may need.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text: You might think gold would better suit a goddess, but no. Silver is what makes her golden hair more beautiful.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text: Now that we're revived, there's a good chance that we may see her again. I don't really mind anything else.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text: I want her spirit and scent to fill this world. I don't want Odin or Heimdall to know our plan.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
Now, this doesn't mean
that I prefer humans over
gods or giants, but if it's for Freya, I'll do anything.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
Anyway, now my brothers
have been revived. For that, I give you my thanks. Someday, you will have the power to challenge the gods.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
Now, I need to
get back to my work.
You'll need a silver ornament for the necklace, so I'll continue to mine silver.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
I will be working
hard to make the most
beautiful ornament
in the world.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
Okay, you
may go back now!
Farewell.

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
Heh heh...
Why are you still
here? Your job is done.
Now, go back to where
you came from!

scripts.speaker: Grer
scripts.text:
Who the
hell are you?!
